effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects and gets -3000 DP.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
